resolved: Public portal no longer embeds internal implementation reports, QA procedures or delivery plans.
Public integration sections are maintained explicitly under docs/api/sections; historical reports stay in repository documentation.
The combined Markdown guide includes all 17 portal guides and serves canonical links.
Outdated v1 multipart-upload guidance is replaced by the available v2 upload route.
Idempotency retention is consistently documented as 90 days; connector deduplication remains distinct.
Postman operation count is derived from the contract instead of a hardcoded number.
Landing shows the actual demonstration GTIN and lot rather than GTIN/LOT placeholders.
Organization verification fields explain the evidence to record; no automatic verification is claimed.
Administrative messages distinguish active capabilities, missing activation, configuration and SMTP probes.
Unavailable services no longer claim an update or development activity is in progress.
Public states use Romanian labels, while API enum values and identifiers remain unchanged.
Badge assessment is explicitly unavailable; hosting and GTIN checks do not grant a badge.
Real limits remain explicit: external sources, custom domains, notifications, mobile distribution and unknown food data.
PBT remains a marked demonstration, R1 remains experimental, and COST3 estimates and original provenance remain unchanged.
